purpose: Targeted generic-only A/B for the preserved order-63 failure: align the model-facing color contract with the Impress Adapter and derive ordered text-box color assignments only from instruction semantics and structural geometry.
change_scope: Reusable Impress text formatting only: parse explicit respectively-plus-visual-order color sequences, resolve nonempty text boxes from presentation.inspect coordinates, inject one exact shape.format_text step at a time, require saved structural read-back, and source shape.format_text schema from the Adapter manifest so standard color names remain valid. No task identity, dataset order, filename, golden value, or evaluator state is a runtime input.

implementation_evidence.counterfactual: A structurally different page 5 contains nested text boxes in shuffled observation order and assigns blue, orange, and magenta from right to left. The test proves no-argument model tools, exact observation-derived paths, saved structural read-back, and an individual retry after one deliberately incorrect color. Additional parser cases use different pages, bottom-to-top order, named colors, and an explicit hex value.
implementation_evidence.preserved_initial_observation_replay: A task-ID-free synthetic replay of the failed run's three slide-1 text-box geometries resolves paths [1], [4], and [0] in top-to-bottom order and maps yellow, red, and LibreOffice green without consulting the golden file or evaluator.
implementation_evidence.prior_v25_outcome: evaluator 0.0 after 15 steps; only the top text box changed because the model confused visible text with exact shape names and then terminated despite contradictory structural read-back
implementation_evidence.osworld_evaluator_tree: frozen commit with zero tracked changes

selection.method: targeted A/B on the first non-pass task after a reusable generic fix
